pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-3248 triggered for runtime-serving in us-east-1 — elevated p50/p95 latency and 500s on /v1/generate. Pager: @marta on-call.

marta: seeing a spike in CUDA OOMs on serve nodes across rack-7. Containers restarting every ~6-8 minutes.

marta: logs show repeated `CUDAMalloc failed` right after a burst of RDMA retransmits. suspect IB backpressure + KV cache eviction cascade.

sam: copying recent node log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T12:07:18Z] serve-worker-23: ERROR RuntimeException: CUDAMalloc failed, requested 1024MB
[2026-03-15T12:07:18Z] serve-worker-23: evicting kvcache entries: prefix=chat/user/.. count=1200
[2026-03-15T12:07:19Z] rdma: retransmit_rate=0.178, rnr_naks=24
[2026-03-15T12:07:19Z] container: restarting (OOM)
```

kai: infra-metrics show IB retransmit spikes starting at 12:05 UTC, tail latency on RPCs climbs, and kvcache eviction rate aligns.

anil: quick ask — can we isolate inter-node traffic to stop cross-host KVCACHE fills? can we flip to local-only kvcache mode?

marta: yes. pushing a runtime flag: `KVCACHE_MODE=local` + reduce max_batch_size to 4 for affected pool. applying now.

infra-bot: deploy started: runtime-config update to pool=kvcache-heavy-us-east, KVCACHE_MODE=local, MAX_BATCH=4 (rolling restart).

sam: also throttling ingress at the edge for the backend route to slow request admission by ~30%. patching rate-limit config.

marta: running `kubectl get pods -n runtime -l pool=kvcache-heavy-us-east -o wide` to target nodes for rolling restarts.

marta: output: 6 pods across nodes serve-21,22,23,24,25,26 — pod 23 keeps flapping.

sam: temporary mitigation: cordon node serve-23 and move its pods to other nodes to avoid repeated local OOMs. doing drain now.

kai: network team: on IB side we see periodic egress queuing on spine-3 -> leaf-7 causing transmit retries. engineering ramping up path-probe frequency to detect link microbursts.

anil: can we also enable node-level fallback to CPU-quantized model for a subset of traffic? that'll reduce GPU mem pressure while we stabilize fabric.

marta: enabling `FALLBACK_CPU_QUANT=true` on canary route. will route 10% traffic to CPU path for now.

pagerduty-bot: escalation: SEV2 -> SEV1 if customer-impact > 30% or if we see full-cluster OOM cascade. current estimate: ~18% request failures based on 5xx rate and sampled traces.

sam: customer-impact note: two enterprise customers (acme-inc, vectra) reported degraded responses and increased latency. support notified and incidents team looping them in.

marta: after KVCACHE_MODE flip + ingress throttle + node drain, error rate dropped from 22% -> 6% over ~6 minutes. GPU OOMs stopped on drained node, but one remaining node (serve-25) still showing transient OOMs.

kai: infra measures: isolating problematic link on leaf-7, rerouting to leaf-9 for the affected TORs. this will take ~8 more minutes for flow draining.

anil: handoff — I need to step out in ~10. @sam can you take primary oncall for next 30m and keep network on pager?

sam: ack. taking over. I'll monitor error rate, kvcache evictions, and IB retransmit metric. will file a follow-up with exact fabirc counters.

marta: notes for post-incident: probable cause = sustained RDMA retransmit bursts causing inter-node latency/backpressure -> aggressive KVCACHE eviction -> increased allocation churn -> GPU memory fragmentation -> CUDAMalloc OOMs -> container restarts.

marta: mitigation checklist applied: 1) KVCACHE_MODE=local 2) MAX_BATCH reduced 3) ingress rate-limited 4) cordon/drain flapping node 5) canary CPU-fallback for 10% 6) network path reroute.

sam: logging action items: - request network to surface IB counters for leaf-7/spine-3 for 11:50-12:20 window; - create a revert-safe playbook for KVCACHE_MODE flip; - run a controlled flood test to validate kvcache eviction thresholds.

infra-bot: added incident P-3248 timeline entry and created ticket INFRA-8764 for network counters.

kai: network follow-up: we'll run a microburst capture on leaf-7 and validate switch buffer utilization; tentative RCA step planned.

sam: current status: p95 latency back to normal, error rate stabilized ~5%. keeping SEV2 open until fabric counters are analyzed and flapping node repro case is resolved. will update every 15m. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks team. handing off to @sam. I'll be on standby for any GPU/OOM regressions.
